name: FormKit Icons
about: FormKit Icons is a free, open-source icon set with 144 icons designed by FormKit, Inc. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under MIT.

faqs.q: Are FormKit Icons free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 144 FormKit Icons are open source under the MIT license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the MIT terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use FormKit Icons in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many FormKit Icons are there?
faqs.a: There are 144 icons in the FormKit Icons set, designed by FormKit, Inc. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of FormKit Icons?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are FormKit Icons available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
